Grammar: negative adverb / modal verb precedes 把 (e.g. 你没把书给我, 我不能把电脑给你)
Grammar: 就 + verb (speaker thinks the action happened early, fast or smoothly)
Grammar: 才 + verb (speaker thinks the action happened late, slowly or unsatisfactorily)
Grammar: A把B+V+给+sb. (action transfers the owner/user of a definite object)
Grammar: place object goes before 来/去 in a compound directional complement (走进教室来)
Grammar: general-item object may go before or after 来/去 in a compound directional complement (买回一个西瓜来 = 买回来一个西瓜)
Grammar: if the action is completed and realized, the object usually goes after 来/去 (哥哥买回来了一个西瓜)
Grammar: 一 in 一边……一边…… can be omitted (边……边……)

这个笔记本电脑我去年买的时候要五千块左右，现在便宜多了。 (Zhège bǐjìběn diànnǎo wǒ qùnián mǎi de shíhou yào wǔ qiān kuài zuǒyòu, xiànzài piányi duō le.) - When I bought this laptop last year it cost about 5,000 yuan; now it is much cheaper.
我想把这个电脑卖了，再买一个更好的。 (Wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhège diànnǎo mài le, zài mǎi yí ge gèng hǎo de.) - I want to sell this computer and buy a better one.

现在我每天起床后的第一件事就是打开电脑，看电子邮件。 (Xiànzài wǒ měi tiān qǐ chuáng hòu de dì yī jiàn shì jiù shì dǎ kāi diànnǎo, kàn diànzǐ yóujiàn.) - Now the first thing I do every day after getting up is to turn on the computer and read e-mail.

我已经很少写信，也很少用笔写字，已经习惯用电脑来学习和工作了。 (Wǒ yǐjīng hěn shǎo xiě xìn, yě hěn shǎo yòng bǐ xiě zì, yǐjīng xíguàn yòng diànnǎo lái xuéxí hé gōngzuò le.) - I already rarely write letters or write with a pen; I am used to using the computer for study and work.
哪一天突然没有了电脑，我们怎么办呢？ (Nǎ yì tiān tūrán méiyǒule diànnǎo, wǒmen zěnme bàn ne?) - What will we do if one day we suddenly have no computers?
请你把衣服洗了。 (Qǐng nǐ bǎ yīfu xǐ le.) - Please wash the clothes.
帮我把这本词典还了。 (Bāng wǒ bǎ zhè běn cídiǎn huán le.) - Help me return this dictionary.
你把灯关了吧。 (Nǐ bǎ dēng guān le ba.) - Turn the light off.
我把爸爸的生日忘了。 (Wǒ bǎ bàba de shēngrì wàng le.) - I forgot Dad's birthday.
你没把书给我。 (Nǐ méi bǎ shū gěi wǒ.) - You didn't give me the book.
你别把手机忘了。 (Nǐ bié bǎ shǒujī wàng le.) - Don't forget your mobile phone.
我不能把电脑给你。 (Wǒ bù néng bǎ diànnǎo gěi nǐ.) - I can't give you the computer.
你可以把空调关了吗？ (Nǐ kěyǐ bǎ kōngtiáo guān le ma?) - Can you turn off the air conditioner?
周末我一般十点左右起床。 (Zhōumò wǒ yìbān shí diǎn zuǒyòu qǐchuáng.) - At weekends I usually get up around ten o'clock.
我们公司有五百人左右。 (Wǒmen gōngsī yǒu wǔ bǎi rén zuǒyòu.) - Our company has about 500 people.
王经理两点左右来了个电话。 (Wáng jīnglǐ liǎng diǎn zuǒyòu láile ge diànhuà.) - Manager Wang phoned at around two o'clock.
这个笔记本电脑我去年买的时候要五千块左右。 (Zhège bǐjìběn diànnǎo wǒ qùnián mǎi de shíhou yào wǔ qiān kuài zuǒyòu.) - When I bought this laptop last year it cost about 5,000 yuan.
离开教室的时候，记得把灯关了。 (Lí kāi jiàoshì de shíhou, jìde bǎ dēng guān le.) - When you leave the classroom, remember to turn off the light.
我去图书馆借本书。 (Wǒ qù túshūguǎn jiè běn shū.) - I am going to the library to borrow a book.
会议结束后，别忘了把空调关了。 (Huìyì jiéshù hòu, bié wàngle bǎ kōngtiáo guān le.) - After the meeting ends, don't forget to turn off the air conditioner.
你爸爸一口酒都不能喝。 (Nǐ bàba yì kǒu jiǔ dōu bù néng hē.) - Your father cannot drink even a mouthful of alcohol.
我已经习惯用电脑来学习和工作了。 (Wǒ yǐjīng xíguàn yòng diànnǎo lái xuéxí hé gōngzuò le.) - I am already used to using the computer to study and work.
好，我马上就去。 (Hǎo, wǒ mǎshàng jiù qù.) - OK, I'll go right away.
明天下午可以吗？ (Míngtiān xiàwǔ kěyǐ ma?) - Is tomorrow afternoon OK?
还是回家吃吧。 (Háishi huí jiā chī ba.) - Let's eat at home instead.
你下课以后常常做什么？ (Nǐ xià kè yǐhòu chángcháng zuò shénme?) - What do you often do after class?
下午两点半。 (Xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn.) - Half past two in the afternoon.
好的，我马上关。 (Hǎo de, wǒ mǎshàng guān.) - OK, I'll turn it off right away.
请问还有多长时间开始？ (Qǐngwèn hái yǒu duō cháng shíjiān kāishǐ?) - Excuse me, how long is it until it starts?
谢谢。 (Xièxie.) - Thank you.
你今天打算几点睡觉？ (Nǐ jīntiān dǎsuàn jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?) - What time do you plan to go to bed today?
没问题。 (Méi wèntí.) - No problem.
昨天谁是最后一个离开办公室的？ (Zuótiān shéi shì zuìhòu yí ge líkāi bàngōngshì de?) - Who was the last person to leave the office yesterday?
对不起，我以后一定不会忘。 (Duìbuqǐ, wǒ yǐhòu yídìng bú huì wàng.) - Sorry, I definitely won't forget in the future.
今天下午你要去见小刚吗？ (Jīntiān xiàwǔ nǐ yào qù jiàn Xiǎogāng ma?) - Are you going to see Xiaogang this afternoon?
没问题，我帮你还他。 (Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ huán tā.) - No problem, I'll return it to him for you.
小明要帮同学做什么？ (Xiǎomíng yào bāng tóngxué zuò shénme?) - What does Xiaoming offer to do for his classmate?
小明告诉同学做什么？ (Xiǎomíng gàosu tóngxué zuò shénme?) - What does Xiaoming tell his classmate to do?
王经理现在在哪儿？ (Wáng jīnglǐ xiànzài zài nǎr?) - Where is Manager Wang now?
周太太今天为什么做了那么多的菜？ (Zhōu tàitai jīntiān wèishénme zuòle nàme duō de cài?) - Why did Mrs Zhou cook so many dishes today?
爸爸能喝酒吗？为什么？ (Bàba néng hē jiǔ ma? Wèishénme?) - Can Dad drink alcohol? Why?
“我”现在每天用电脑做什么？ ("Wǒ" xiànzài měi tiān yòng diànnǎo zuò shénme?) - What does "I" use the computer for every day now?
在你们国家，一个手机多少钱？ (Zài nǐmen guójiā, yí ge shǒujī duōshao qián?) - In your country, how much is a mobile phone?
在我们国家，一个手机2000块左右。 (Zài wǒmen guójiā, yí ge shǒujī liǎng qiān kuài zuǒyòu.) - In our country a mobile phone costs about 2,000 yuan.
今天下了课我要去图书馆把书还了。 (Jīntiān xiàle kè wǒ yào qù túshūguǎn bǎ shū huán le.) - After class today I am going to the library to return the book.

“贵人多忘事”，这里的“贵人”是做大官的人或者做大生意的人。 ("Guìrén duō wàng shì", zhèlǐ de "guìrén" shì zuò dà guān de rén huòzhě zuò dà shēngyi de rén.) - In "贵人多忘事", "贵人" means a person who holds high office or does big business.

这句话的意思是做大官或者做大生意的人因为事情太多，所以常常会忘记做一些小事。 (Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì zuò dà guān huòzhě zuò dà shēngyi de rén yīnwèi shìqing tài duō, suǒyǐ chángcháng huì wàngjì zuò yìxiē xiǎo shì.) - The saying means that people in high office or in big business often forget trivial things because they have too much to do.

现在一般用在对话中表示客气，说明一个人工作太忙，事情太多，忘记一些小事是可以理解的，有时候也有一种讽刺的意味。 (Xiànzài yìbān yòng zài duìhuà zhōng biǎoshì kèqi, shuōmíng yí ge rén gōngzuò tài máng, shìqing tài duō, wàngjì yìxiē xiǎo shì shì kěyǐ lǐjiě de, yǒu shíhou yě yǒu yì zhǒng fěngcì de yìwèi.) - Now it is generally used in conversation to be polite, showing that someone is so busy that forgetting small things is understandable; sometimes it also carries an ironic tone.
把重要的东西放在我这儿吧 (Bǎ zhòngyào de dōngxi fàng zài wǒ zhèr ba) - Leave the important items with me
今天太阳从西边出来了吗？ (Jīntiān tàiyáng cóng xībian chūlai le ma?) - Has the sun come up from the west today?
怎么了？ (Zěnme le?) - What's the matter?
你怎么这么早就要睡觉了？ (Nǐ zěnme zhème zǎo jiù yào shuì jiào le?) - Why are you going to bed so early?
以前都要12点以后才睡觉。 (Yǐqián dōu yào shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu cái shuì jiào.) - You used to go to bed only after 12 o'clock.
我明天8点就要到公司。 (Wǒ míngtiān bā diǎn jiù yào dào gōngsī.) - I have to be at the company by 8 o'clock tomorrow.
有事吗？ (Yǒu shì ma?) - Is something up?

经理生气了，他告诉我，明天8点不到，以后就别来了。 (Jīnglǐ shēng qì le, tā gàosu wǒ, míngtiān bā diǎn bú dào, yǐhòu jiù bié lái le.) - The manager is angry; he told me that if I'm not there by 8 tomorrow, I needn't come any more.
我要跟周经理去外地办事，明天的飞机。 (Wǒ yào gēn Zhōu jīnglǐ qù wàidì bàn shì, míngtiān de fēijī.) - I'm going to another city on business with Manager Zhou; the flight is tomorrow.
那我帮你把衣服放到行李箱里吧。 (Nà wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ yīfu fàngdào xínglixiāng li ba.) - Then let me put your clothes in the suitcase for you.
什么时候回来？ (Shénme shíhou huílai?) - When will you be back?
一个星期就回来。 (Yí ge xīngqī jiù huílai.) - I'll be back in a week.
啊？一个星期以后才回来？ (Á? Yí ge xīngqī yǐhòu cái huílai?) - What? You won't be back until a week later?
你要自己照顾好自己，我已经给你准备好吃的和喝的了。 (Nǐ yào zìjǐ zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ, wǒ yǐjīng gěi nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo chī de hé hē de le.) - You must look after yourself; I have already prepared food and drink for you.
好吧。 (Hǎo ba.) - All right.
我已经把我的照片放在你的包里了。 (Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ wǒ de zhàopiàn fàng zài nǐ de bāo li le.) - I have already put my photo in your bag.
你怎么才来？ (Nǐ zěnme cái lái?) - Why have you only just arrived?

对不起，周经理，来机场的路上我才发现忘带护照了。 (Duìbuqǐ, Zhōu jīnglǐ, lái jīchǎng de lùshang wǒ cái fāxiàn wàng dài hùzhào le.) - Sorry, Manager Zhou, only on the way to the airport did I discover I'd forgotten my passport.
快点吧，飞机就要起飞了。 (Kuài diǎnr ba, fēijī jiù yào qǐfēi le.) - Hurry up, the plane is about to take off.
您有钱吗？ (Nín yǒu qián ma?) - Do you have any money?
司机把我送到机场的时候，我才发现忘记带钱包了。 (Sījī bǎ wǒ sòng dào jīchǎng de shíhou, wǒ cái fāxiàn wàngjì dài qiánbāo le.) - Only when the driver took me to the airport did I discover I'd forgotten my wallet.
我看你还是把重要的东西放在我这儿吧。 (Wǒ kàn nǐ háishi bǎ zhòngyào de dōngxi fàng zài wǒ zhèr ba.) - I think you had better leave the important things with me.
我是一个中学老师，教学生画画儿。 (Wǒ shì yí ge zhōngxué lǎoshī, jiāo xuésheng huà huàr.) - I am a middle-school teacher and teach students to draw.

每次下课前，我都会把下次学生需要带的东西写在黑板上，但是每次上课时，总会有学生忘了拿铅笔，所以我有点儿生气，不是因为他们没带铅笔，是因为他们没有好的学习习惯。 (Měi cì xià kè qián, wǒ dōu huì bǎ xià cì xuésheng xūyào dài de dōngxi xiě zài hēibǎn shang, dànshì měi cì shàng kè shí, zǒng huì yǒu xuésheng wàngle ná qiānbǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ yǒudiǎnr shēng qì, bú shì yīnwèi tāmen méi dài qiānbǐ, shì yīnwèi tāmen méiyǒu hǎo de xuéxí xíguàn.) - Before each class ends I write on the blackboard what students need to bring next time, but every class some student forgets a pencil, so I am a bit angry - not because they didn't bring a pencil, but because they lack good study habits.
我早上五点就起床了。 (Wǒ zǎoshang wǔ diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.) - I got up as early as five in the morning.
坐飞机一个小时就到了。 (Zuò fēijī yí ge xiǎoshí jiù dào le.) - By plane it takes only an hour to get there.
我很容易就找到了他的家。 (Wǒ hěn róngyì jiù zhǎodàole tā de jiā.) - I found his home very easily.
你怎么这么早就要睡觉了？ (Nǐ zěnme zhème zǎo jiù yào shuì jiào le?) - Why are you going to bed so early?
八点上课，他九点才起床。 (Bā diǎn shàng kè, tā jiǔ diǎn cái qǐchuáng.) - Class starts at eight, yet he doesn't get up until nine.
坐火车八个小时才能到。 (Zuò huǒchē bā ge xiǎoshí cái néng dào.) - By train it takes eight hours to get there.
弟弟三个小时才做完作业。 (Dìdi sān ge xiǎoshí cái zuòwán zuòyè.) - It took my younger brother three hours to finish his homework.
来机场的路上我才发现忘带护照了。 (Lái jīchǎng de lùshang wǒ cái fāxiàn wàng dài hùzhào le.) - Only on the way to the airport did I discover I had forgotten my passport.
我把照片放在你包里了。 (Wǒ bǎ zhàopiàn fàng zài nǐ bāo li le.) - I put the photo in your bag.
老师把作业放在桌子上了。 (Lǎoshī bǎ zuòyè fàng zài zhuōzi shang le.) - The teacher put the homework on the desk.
我没把裤子放到椅子上。 (Wǒ méi bǎ kùzi fàngdào yǐzi shang.) - I didn't put the trousers on the chair.
我帮你把衣服放到行李箱里吧。 (Wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ yīfu fàngdào xínglixiāng li ba.) - Let me put the clothes in the suitcase for you.
我把鲜花送给老师了。 (Wǒ bǎ xiānhuā sòng gěi lǎoshī le.) - I gave the flowers to the teacher.
我朋友把书借给我了。 (Wǒ péngyou bǎ shū jiè gěi wǒ le.) - My friend lent me the book.
弟弟没把钱还给哥哥。 (Dìdi méi bǎ qián huán gěi gēge.) - My younger brother didn't return the money to his elder brother.
你帮我把这本书带给小刚。 (Nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ zhè běn shū dài gěi Xiǎogāng.) - Please take this book to Xiaogang for me.
经理生气了。 (Jīnglǐ shēng qì le.) - The manager got angry.
你要自己照顾好自己。 (Nǐ yào zìjǐ zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ.) - You must take good care of yourself.
来机场的路上我才发现忘带护照了。 (Lái jīchǎng de lùshang wǒ cái fāxiàn wàng dài hùzhào le.) - Only on the way to the airport did I discover I had forgotten my passport.
我教学生画画儿。 (Wǒ jiāo xuésheng huà huàr.) - I teach students to draw.
我把需要带的东西写在黑板上。 (Wǒ bǎ xūyào dài de dōngxi xiě zài hēibǎn shang.) - I write the things that need to be brought on the blackboard.
我现在能去一下洗手间吗？ (Wǒ xiànzài néng qù yíxià xǐshǒujiān ma?) - Can I go to the washroom now?
你怎么了？ (Nǐ zěnme le?) - What's wrong with you?
是吗？今天我也去买一块。 (Shì ma? Jīntiān wǒ yě qù mǎi yí kuài.) - Really? I'll go and buy a piece today too.
我的衣服太多了！ (Wǒ de yīfu tài duō le!) - I have too many clothes!
我出国一个星期，你怎么办？ (Wǒ chū guó yí ge xīngqī, nǐ zěnme bàn?) - I'll be abroad for a week; what will you do?
你怎么不上飞机？ (Nǐ zěnme bú shàng fēijī?) - Why aren't you boarding the plane?
那怎么办？ (Nà zěnme bàn?) - Then what shall we do?
起晚了，还等了半天公共汽车。 (Qǐ wǎn le, hái děngle bàntiān gōnggòng qìchē.) - I got up late and also waited ages for the bus.
你的车呢？ (Nǐ de chē ne?) - Where is your car?
你带我们去游泳吧。 (Nǐ dài wǒmen qù yóuyǒng ba.) - Take us swimming.
行，你是刚学会游泳吗？ (Xíng, nǐ shì gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng ma?) - OK - did you only just learn to swim?
起床吧，已经8点了。 (Qǐchuáng ba, yǐjīng bā diǎn le.) - Get up, it's already 8 o'clock.
那我先起来了。我的眼镜呢？ (Nà wǒ xiān qǐlái le. Wǒ de yǎnjìng ne?) - Then I'll get up first. Where are my glasses?
小刚平时几点睡觉？今天呢？ (Xiǎo Gāng píngshí jǐ diǎn shuìjiào? Jīntiān ne?) - What time does Xiaogang usually go to bed? And today?
小刚什么时候出差回来？ (Xiǎo Gāng shénme shíhou chūchāi huílái?) - When does Xiaogang come back from his business trip?
小刚给小丽准备了什么？小丽呢？ (Xiǎo Gāng gěi Xiǎo Lì zhǔnbèile shénme? Xiǎo Lì ne?) - What did Xiaogang prepare for Xiaoli? And Xiaoli?
小刚今天忘带什么了？ (Xiǎo Gāng jīntiān wàng dài shénme le?) - What did Xiaogang forget to bring today?
每次下课以前，老师会做什么？ (Měi cì xiàkè yǐqián, lǎoshī huì zuò shénme?) - What does the teacher do before each class ends?
老师为什么有点儿生气？ (Lǎoshī wèishénme yǒudiǎnr shēngqì?) - Why is the teacher a bit angry?
我每天早上6点就起床。 (Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng.) - I get up at 6 every morning.
我每天早上8点才起床。 (Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang bā diǎn cái qǐchuáng.) - I don't get up until 8 every morning.
我把电脑放在桌子上。 (Wǒ bǎ diànnǎo fàng zài zhuōzi shang.) - I put my computer on the desk.
我们都把电脑放在桌子上。 (Wǒmen dōu bǎ diànnǎo fàng zài zhuōzi shang.) - We all put our computers on the desk.
“习惯成自然”，这里“成”是变成的意思。 ("Xíguàn chéng zìrán", zhèlǐ "chéng" shì biànchéng de yìsi.) - In "习惯成自然", "成" means "to become".

这句话的意思是，平时做事的方法习惯了，慢慢就变成自然的事了，很难再改变了。 (Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì, píngshí zuò shì de fāngfǎ xíguàn le, mànmàn jiù biànchéng zìrán de shì le, hěn nán zài gǎibiàn le.) - The saying means that once the way you usually do something becomes a habit, it gradually becomes natural and hard to change.

这句话告诉我们要养成好的习惯，不要觉得不好的事情只做一次没关系，如果不注意，慢慢就会变成很自然的事，到时候就不容易发现错误，也不容易改变了。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen yào yǎngchéng hǎo de xíguàn, bú yào juéde bù hǎo de shìqing zhǐ zuò yí cì méi guānxi, rúguǒ bú zhùyì, mànmàn jiù huì biànchéng hěn zìrán de shì, dào shíhou jiù bù róngyì fāxiàn cuòwù, yě bù róngyì gǎibiàn le.) - It tells us to form good habits and not to think a bad thing done just once does not matter; if we are not careful it gradually becomes natural, and then the mistake is hard to notice or change.
我是走回来的 (Wǒ shì zǒu huilai de) - I walked back
你终于回来了！ (Nǐ zhōngyú huílai le!) - You're finally back!
从哪儿买回来这么多东西啊？ (Cóng nǎr mǎi huilai zhème duō dōngxi a?) - Where did you buy all these things?
都是从那边的商店买回来的。 (Dōu shì cóng nà bian de shāngdiàn mǎi huilai de.) - I bought them all from the shops over there.
怎么还买红酒回来了？ (Zěnme hái mǎi hóngjiǔ huilai le?) - Why did you also buy red wine?
谁喝啊？ (Shéi hē a?) - Who's going to drink it?

这是给爷爷的礼物，明天我们一起送过去，看看爷爷奶奶。 (Zhè shì gěi yéye de lǐwù, míngtiān wǒmen yìqǐ sòng guoqu, kànkan yéye nǎinai.) - This is a gift for Grandpa; tomorrow we'll take it over together and visit Grandpa and Grandma.
那我的礼物呢？ (Nà wǒ de lǐwù ne?) - Then where is my gift?
快拿出来让我看看。 (Kuài ná chulai ràng wǒ kànkan.) - Quick, take it out and let me see.
我不是已经回来了吗？ (Wǒ bú shì yǐjīng huílai le ma?) - Haven't I already come back?
我今天看见你和一个女的进了咖啡店，她是谁啊？ (Wǒ jīntiān kànjiàn nǐ hé yí ge nǚ de jìnle kāfēidiàn, tā shì shéi a?) - I saw you go into a coffee shop with a woman today. Who is she?
她是我今天在路上遇到的一个老同学。 (Tā shì wǒ jīntiān zài lùshang yùdào de yí ge lǎo tóngxué.) - She is an old classmate I ran into on the road today.
你们就一起去喝咖啡了？ (Nǐmen jiù yìqǐ qù hē kāfēi le?) - So you went for coffee together?
是啊，一边喝咖啡一边说了些过去的事。 (Shì a, yìbiān hē kāfēi yìbiān shuōle xiē guòqù de shì.) - Yes, we talked about past events while drinking coffee.
你回来得这么晚，是说了很多过去的事吗？ (Nǐ huílai de zhème wǎn, shì shuōle hěn duō guòqù de shì ma?) - You came back so late - did you talk about lots of past events?
不是。 (Bú shì.) - No.
没有公共汽车了，我是走回来的。 (Méiyǒu gōnggòng qìchē le, wǒ shì zǒu huilai de.) - There were no more buses, so I walked back.
小丽，周末你一般跟小刚出去看电影吗？ (Xiǎolì, zhōumò nǐ yìbān gēn Xiǎogāng chūqu kàn diànyǐng ma?) - Xiaoli, do you usually go out to the cinema with Xiaogang at weekends?
我很少去电影院看电影，我更愿意在家看电视。 (Wǒ hěn shǎo qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng, wǒ gèng yuànyì zài jiā kàn diànshì.) - I rarely go to the cinema; I would rather watch TV at home.
看电视有什么意思啊？ (Kàn diànshì yǒu shénme yìsi a?) - What's fun about watching TV?
可以一边吃一边看，坐久了还可以站起来休息一会儿。 (Kěyǐ yìbiān chī yìbiān kàn, zuò jiǔ le hái kěyǐ zhàn qilai xiūxi yíhuìr.) - I can eat while watching, and after sitting for a long time I can stand up and rest a while.
你应该多出去走走，这样你们的生活会更有意思。 (Nǐ yīnggāi duō chūqu zǒuzou, zhèyàng nǐmen de shēnghuó huì gèng yǒu yìsi.) - You should go out and walk around more; that way your life will be more interesting.
有他在，我的生活已经很有意思了。 (Yǒu tā zài, wǒ de shēnghuó yǐjīng hěn yǒu yìsi le.) - With him around, my life is already very interesting.

刚结婚的时候，我丈夫是中学老师，他喜欢每天早上起床后，一边吃早饭一边看报纸。 (Gāng jié hūn de shíhou, wǒ zhàngfu shì zhōngxué lǎoshī, tā xǐhuan měi tiān zǎoshang qǐ chuáng hòu, yìbiān chī zǎofàn yìbiān kàn bàozhǐ.) - When we had just married, my husband was a middle-school teacher; every morning after getting up he liked to read the newspaper while eating breakfast.

十年过去了，现在他已经是校长了，因为太忙，每天早上我起床后都看不到他，晚上很晚他才回到家。 (Shí nián guòqù le, xiànzài tā yǐjīng shì xiàozhǎng le, yīnwèi tài máng, měi tiān zǎoshang wǒ qǐ chuáng hòu dōu kàn bu dào tā, wǎnshang hěn wǎn tā cái huí dào jiā.) - Ten years have passed and now he is the headmaster; because he is so busy I can't see him when I get up each morning, and he gets home only very late at night.
我真怕他累坏了。 (Wǒ zhēn pà tā lèihuài le.) - I'm really afraid he will wear himself out.

希望他能少一些会议，多一些休息，可以经常和我还有孩子在一起。 (Xīwàng tā néng shǎo yìxiē huìyì, duō yìxiē xiūxi, kěyǐ jīngcháng hé wǒ hái yǒu háizi zài yìqǐ.) - I hope he can have fewer meetings and more rest, and be able to be with me and the child often.

周太太走进咖啡店去。 (Zhōu tàitai zǒu jìn kāfēidiàn qù.) - Mrs Zhou walked into the coffee shop.
下课了，同学们走出教室去。 (Xià kè le, tóngxuémen zǒu chū jiàoshì qù.) - Class is over and the students walked out of the classroom.
